v1.0.29+36 - Promotional Deep-Linking & Complete Purge of Synthetic Video Tutorials from Public Catalog
- Eradicated Static Data: 100% eliminated fake/synthetic video tutorials and syllabus lesson fallbacks from the public catalog; strictly renders genuine database guest tutorials with verified time_pass_enabled = true.
- Default Public Catalog View: Set 'All Items' as the primary first view displaying authentic digital music books and student store merchandise.
- Dynamic Poster Deep-Linking: Launch posters now deep-link directly to specific song tutorials (launching player/time pass), academic courses (auto-opening syllabus), or digital store products (launching instant M-Pesa prompt).
